name: B10-0313/2026 (ESN) – Political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on three people held by Nicaragua's government. It says Brooklyn Rivera died in custody and calls for an independent investigation. It says Carlos Brenes and his wife Salvadora del Socorro Martinez Aburto were jailed for 15 years and should get lawyers and medical care. It asks Nicaragua to free everyone held for political reasons and asks the European Union to press Nicaragua's authorities.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states demands to Nicaragua's government.
- It concerns Rivera's family, Brenes, his wife and other prisoners in Nicaragua.
- Next, the text goes to European Union bodies and Nicaragua's authorities; no vote result is given.
